events.title: DIGSITE ZERO DEMO - Perfected!

events.title: DIGSITE ZERO Demo Update #1 is Live!

events.title: Playtest DIGSITE ZERO closed!
events.summary: Registration for the DIGSITE ZERO playtest is now closed, and the playtest itself has ended. I will now use the feedback I’ve collected to further develop the project. I’d like to thank everyone who shared their thoughts after playing this 30-minute test version.
